name: Encroachment

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you need to secure Durotar from the native Razormane quilboar to establish a safe, lasting homeland.
As an orc, you claim Durotar as your new homeland. The Razormane bramble dens still threaten your settlements.

faq.answer: Gar'Thok, an orc officer stationed at Razor Hill in central Durotar, gives the order.

When the orcs arrived in Durotar, the Razormane quilboar held much of the region. The Horde drove most of them back, but fortified pockets remain west of Razor Hill and threaten the safety of the new orc homeland.
faq.q: Why is the Horde fighting the Razormane quilboar in Durotar?

faq.answer: The Razormane camps lie west of Razor Hill, among dense tangles of thorny brambles.
faq.q: Where are the Razormane camps located?

faq.answer: The Razormane are a hostile tribe of quilboar native to Kalimdor's arid plains. They build defensive bramble dens and fiercely resist the Horde's settlement of Durotar and the Barrens.
After the quilboar are defeated, Gar'Thok sends word to burn their cleared brambles and structures. This strengthens Horde control of the area and secures Durotar's borders.
faq.q: What happens once the quilboar are defeated?

faq.answer: Razor Hill is a fortified orc settlement in central Durotar. It is a military and logistical hub between the Valley of Trials and Orgrimmar.
faq.q: What is Razor Hill's role in this conflict?

sections.body: When Thrall brought the orcs to Kalimdor and founded Durotar, the Razormane already ranged across much of the harsh, arid land. These aggressive, boar-like quilboar became a constant danger to the new settlement. The Horde drove most of them back through sustained military efforts. Yet fortified pockets remain in thorned redoubts west of Razor Hill.
sections.title: A Thorn in Durotar's Side

sections.body: Gar'Thok, an officer at Razor Hill, leads the effort to remove the remaining Razormane. He sends seasoned defenders into the western bramble camps to kill their scouts, warriors, and dustrunners. Gar'Thok and the Horde leadership fear any quilboar foothold near Razor Hill could bring disaster. They see this strike as the first step toward securing Kalimdor.
sections.title: Gar'Thok's Offensive

sections.body: Once the quilboar defenders are gone, Horde forces can burn the bramble dens and keep the Razormane from reclaiming the western foothills. The fire destroys an enduring menace and secures Durotar's western perimeter. It also protects the vital supply roads between Razor Hill and the wider realm.
sections.title: Clearing the Brambles

summary: At Razor Hill in central Durotar, Gar'Thok sends you west against Razormane camps. Their fortified dens still threaten the young orc homeland.
